name: Salesforce
description: Salesforce sells subscription business software, mainly customer relationship management (tracking sales, customer service, marketing and commerce) hosted in the cloud, now branded around AI agents (Agentforce). 95% of revenue is subscription and support billed annually, usually in advance, with a small consulting and implementation arm. It has grown in large part by acquisition: Slack, Tableau, MuleSoft and, closing November 2025, Informatica (data management), and in 2026 Qualified, Contentful and Intercom. No customer is more than 10% of revenue. Revenue growth has slowed to around 10 to 12% a year and cash goes mainly to buybacks, with a dividend.

businessLines.name: Agentforce Sales
businessLines.how: Per-user annual subscriptions for sales-team software (lead and opportunity tracking), billed yearly in advance; growth comes from more seats and add-on AI features.

businessLines.name: Agentforce Service
businessLines.how: Per-user subscriptions for customer-support software, plus usage-based charges for AI agent actions.

businessLines.name: Agentforce 360 Platform, Slack and Other
businessLines.how: Subscriptions for the underlying app-building platform, Slack seats and other products.

businessLines.name: Agentforce Integration and Analytics (MuleSoft, Tableau, Informatica)
businessLines.how: Subscriptions and consumption-based licences for connecting and analysing corporate data.
